coverage: Xdebug executed line coverage in kwasii/laravel-sql-parser PHP source (Tokenizer, Parser, the base Dialect and the Expression node classes); php-fuzzer basic-block instrumentation for fuzz entry
scope: SQL text from local bytes passed to Dialect::get(null)->parse() (sqlglot's base dialect), which tokenizes the text and returns one expression tree per ';'-separated statement (Select, Insert). The harness reads Select expressions, where, group and order and Insert Schema columns and Values tuples, and walks each tree with Expression::dfs() for Table names, Join nodes, Func call names (Anonymous name or the class SQL name; And/Or connectors excluded) and Literal nodes (is_string flag and token text). The Laravel facade, transpiler, generator and optimizer are not used.
dialect: sqlglot base dialect (Dialect::get(null); the package also offers MySQL, Postgres, SQLite and other dialects)
parser_family: kwasii/laravel-sql-parser: PHP port of sqlglot 30.21.0 (Python; its README and generated node classes name sqlglot as the source) with its own tokenizer, recursive-descent parser and expression classes; shares design lineage with the Python sqlglot path but no code with the phpMyAdmin, PHP-SQL-Parser, pg_builder, crodas, libpg_query, bleksak or vimeo code bases
api: Kwasii\LaravelSqlParser\Dialects\Dialect::get(null)->parse(local SQL text) -> list of Expression trees (Expressions\Select, Expressions\Insert, ...)
